proposedApi.details: inspectPending(accountRef): Result<readonly ModelAdmissionRecordV1[]> and resumePending(accountRef, callKey): Result<ModelAdmissionRecordV1> are additive methods on ModelAdmissionApi using existing public DTOs. The current API has no pending-list/resume methods; no new schema or DTO is needed for these signatures.

queueEligibility.details: Scope resume candidates to current-account/current-day, uncharged denied rows with native_send_count=0, no terminal acknowledgement, ended_at=NULL, durable retryAt, measured-threshold hold reasons (five-hour, weekly or reservation threshold), and assigned autonomous classes. This excludes uncertain, sending, settled, charged history and foreground work from re-admission. Charged rows, including charged-denied history, remain readable/idempotent but never resume candidates. Owner SQL binds accountRef and ranks internally; caller input cannot select or sort the head.

sameRowDeniedToReserved.details: Existing table checks permit denied/unleased/uncharged to become reserved/leased/charged with native_send_count still zero. The guard freezes request identity/bindings/costs and utc_day, blocks edits to settled rows and blocks charged=true to false, but does not freeze decision/state or false-to-true charge. No migration is needed for a same-day retry that preserves all frozen columns.

exactlyOnceCharge.details: The existing guard makes charges monotonic but does not itself prevent a duplicate budget counter increment. The resume mutation must update only a still-denied, uncharged head, and increment its existing budget counters only when that conditional row transition returns a row. A changed-row replay must return the persisted row without rerunning the charge CTE.

idempotencyAndUncertain.details: Check the addressed row before queue-head evaluation: if the same callKey is already reserved, sending, uncertain, settled, or any charged state including denied-but-charged, return its persisted record without mutation or queue advancement. Only an uncharged denied measured-threshold row may be re-evaluated. Uncertain/charged rows are never re-admitted; the guard also refuses charge reclamation.

mutationConcurrency.details: The existing accounting mutation obtains pg_advisory_xact_lock(18374691). Recheck the selected pending head and snapshot inside the same mutation statement after that lock; a pre-lock read alone is insufficient.

findings.details: The updated plan's implementation description and CLI phases cover inspectPending/resumePending and wrong-head retries, but do not explicitly change or test the existing fresh reserve path. Current ModelAdmission.reserve reads the ledger and evaluates one request; it does not inspect higher-priority denied rows. A fresh repair/quiet request can therefore reserve while a higher-priority event/continuation row is pending, bypassing ADR-0053's explicit fresh-reserve rule.
findings.requiredClosure: Add the existing reserve path to the owner change: under the same advisory mutation lock, check for higher-priority measured-threshold pending work and prevent a lower-priority fresh request from taking the lease or charging ahead of it. Add a public CLI assertion for that fresh-reserve attempt, including that no prior row or budget charge is changed. Keep deferred measured-threshold work durable with reason/retryAt; never reopen charged history.

findings.details: The proposed queue eligibility filters to current UTC day, while measured-window retryAt is a quota-window reset and can fall on a later day. The row's utc_day is immutable. Such a denied weekly-window row will disappear from inspectPending after midnight and cannot be resumed by this same-row API later without either violating day-bound accounting or adding a new retry-record relationship.
findings.requiredClosure: Scope this card and its proof explicitly to same-UTC-day measured-threshold resumes, or define how a later-day retry is represented and charged without mutating the old row or weakening the no-reclamation rule. Do not claim general cross-day durable resume or broaden this into a second queue.

conclusion: The same-row transition and existing guard support a same-day measured-threshold retry; budget charging still needs a conditional transition CTE. Charged-denied rows must be idempotent readbacks only, never resume candidates. ADR-0053 is directionally sound, but the implementation plan must explicitly close the fresh-reserve bypass and state the cross-day wake limit before source work.
writeScope: Only build/evidence/R0.11/ordered-pause-interface-review.json was written. No source, build, tests, generator, CLI, account, credential or external service was touched.
